reason: Fix reward hacking where agent accumulates dense success bonus (+100/step) while hovering on ground without terminating. Change success bonus to sparse (terminal only). Increase step penalty (-0.2 -> -0.5) to discourage long episodes and enforce time pressure, aligning with Iteration 3->4 memory evidence.
changed_design: landing_success_bonus: Changed from dense state-based to sparse terminal-only trigger.
step_penalty: Increased magnitude from -0.2 to -0.5 per step.
risk: Higher step penalty may cause agent to rush and crash initially before learning safe descent.
Sparse success reward might slow convergence if shaping signals are insufficient (mitigated by existing position/velocity terms).

expected_metric_changes.fitness_score: Initial drop possible due to higher step penalty, followed by recovery as landing terminates episodes.

validation_metrics.name: average_steps_to_termination
validation_metrics.purpose: Verify agent stops hovering and attempts termination faster.

validation_metrics.name: success_like_terminal_rate
validation_metrics.purpose: Ensure landing attempts result in valid success states at episode end.

validation_metrics.name: mean_orientation_penalty_per_step
validation_metrics.purpose: Confirm agent maintains upright orientation during descent.
